- Added `OffloadKey`, a `NamedTuple` of `(block_hash: BlockHash, group_idx: int)` — hashable and equality-comparable, so it works as a dict/set key and distinguishes blocks from different KV cache groups (same content hash, different group → distinct keys).

- `PrepareStoreOutput`: `block_hashes_to_store` → `keys_to_store: list[OffloadKey]`, `block_hashes_evicted` → `evicted_keys: list[OffloadKey]`.

- `OffloadingManager`: all block-identifier params (`lookup`, `prepare_load`, `prepare_store`, `touch`, `complete_load`, `complete_store`) now take `Iterable[OffloadKey]`.

## `vllm/v1/kv_offload/cpu/manager.py`
- `CPUOffloadingManager` now uses `OffloadKey` throughout (pool allocation, policy lookups, event emission, and the renamed `keys_to_store`/`evicted_keys`/`keys` fields).
